⚡ How I Connect My AI Agents: https://bit.ly/3WlGNhZ
📈 Grab Agentic OS + Full Course & Community: https://bit.ly/4kol0y5

👋 Howdy
Hey, I'm Jack, I built and sold my last tech startup with a Gazillion customers, now I'm building AI startups and I share stuff that works. I quit my corporate job to do my start-up and have never looked back since.

💬 Overview
Ten free GitHub repos worth installing this week, with every link below. PhotoCraft and Compositor are open-source versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro and the rest of the Adobe suite, and Claude can edit inside them for you. Ego Lite is a browser for AI agents that runs in the background with your logged-in sessions. Rea shows how any app does something, then builds the same feature into your project. 21st.dev and its MCP give Claude a huge library of UI components. Find Skills picks the right skill for a task, Orca runs many agents side by side, and Zapier MCP gives every agent one shared set of connections. Arena Skill makes 100 answers face off until one wins, Universal Modder mods any game, and Cloudflare's security audit skill checks your app before you ship. SlopMonster closes it out. You'll see what each one does and how to get it running.

Btw when you work on a similar project, you can just claude to take a look at the codebases of others, take inspiration and improve your app.

I was making my own Video Editing software, and claude found some interesting improvements to take from their codebase into mine. 


Open-source and cross sharing of code between projects is gonna be amazing. Especially if their based on the same coding language, which is usually rust.
